# ScriptDB documentation

> Lightweight synchronous and asynchronous SQLite wrapper for Python.

ScriptDB documentation:

- [Home](index.md): Overview, supported interfaces, and requirements.
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): Installation, lifecycle, options, and row factories.
- [Migrations](migrations.md): SQL, callable, and Builder migrations.
- [CRUD and queries](queries.md): Execution, inserts, updates, upserts, deletes, and query helpers.
- [Transactions and hooks](transactions-hooks.md): Transactions, periodic hooks, query-count hooks, and lifecycle guards.
- [Async API](async.md): Async operations, transactions, worker threads, and signal handling.
- [Cache API](cache.md): Persistent key-value cache, TTL, decorators, and RAM index.
- [SQL Builder](builder.md): CREATE, ALTER, DROP, indexes, and inferred schemas.
- [API reference](api.md): Compact public API reference.
- [SQLite troubleshooting](sqlite.md): Backend selection and pysqlite diagnostics.
